application_answers.short_description: Proactive general agent for your whole life
application_answers.problem: A person's health, mental wellbeing, money, schedules, applications, work, crypto, and investing are fragmented across tools. Advice is abundant, but dependable follow-through is scarce.
application_answers.solution: Life Manager coordinates specialist organs, acts within delegated boundaries across those systems, verifies outcomes with receipts, and reports concise evidence in Telegram.
application_answers.why_building: The founder is building the manager he needs personally: one dependable agent that does not stop at advice and can carry real goals through disconnected systems. The long-term mission is to end suffering for humans and ultimately all living beings.
application_answers.progress: The open-source local runtime, hosted components, Telegram entry point, and multiple specialist loops exist. The founder attests that Life Manager has generated approximately $1,000 in revenue for its founder; this is not claimed as MRR or ARR.
application_answers.market: The initial users are founders and professionals whose lives and work span many disconnected systems. The broader market is anyone who needs trusted execution across health, work, and finances; do not invent a numeric TAM without current sourced evidence.
application_answers.business_model: A free open-source self-hosted option drives trust and adoption. An always-on hosted Life Manager is sold as a paid monthly cloud subscription.
application_answers.differentiation: Life Manager is a manager rather than a chat assistant or dashboard: it takes authorized action, coordinates specialized agents, preserves provenance, and distinguishes attempts from provider-verified completion.
application_answers.how_built: One general-agent harness uses models for semantic judgment and unfamiliar interfaces, while deterministic code owns permissions, money arithmetic, state transitions, deduplication, receipts, and scheduling.
application_answers.use_of_funds: Improve reliable agent execution, expand secure integrations, strengthen evidence-backed verification, and deliver the always-on cloud product to early users.
